scope: Multi-seed MC decomposition — identical 200 PI candidates (fixed θ), M=20 seeds/candidate/arm, per-(cand,seed) PAIRED seeds, committed-4.2 vs hardened. Averages out intra-candidate Y-stream sampling noise.
conclusion: λ-lapse SYSTEMATICALLY increases REFER (ΔP(refer)=+0.0410 ± 0.0028, >0 at >2·SE) — the expected conservative mechanism, now an averaged (not noisy) estimate. The pass-share-of-decisive shift is +0.0145 ± 0.0028 (NOT consistent with 0 — a systematic pass/fail bias exists; investigate before sign-off). ΔP(pass)=-0.0106±0.0020, ΔP(fail)=-0.0303±0.0024 — FAIL-mass drops ~2.9× more than PASS-mass (REFER absorbs ASYMMETRICALLY, slightly toward leniency among decisive verdicts).
interpretation: HONEST (the strengthening OVERTURNED the single-run 'just sampling noise' hypothesis — exactly why this MC was run). The pass/fail-balance shift is REAL and systematic (+0.0145, ~5·SE) but SMALL (~1.5pp toward leniency among decisive cases) and is DWARFED by the universal conservative REFER increase (+0.041). Single-seed per-task corroboration (phase4_3_hardening_delta.json) shows the aggregate is the NET of HETEROGENEOUS, OPPOSING per-task shifts (e.g. spike/lrda → lenient via FAIL→REFER; lpd/seizure → stricter via PASS→REFER) — NOT a clean ℓ*-monotone trend and NOT a fundamental flaw of the lapse likelihood (which is the REFERENCE-CORRECT model). It is a per-task boundary-interaction between λ-attenuated extreme evidence and where each task ℓ* sits in the skill distribution — measured here under the PI-FAITHFUL ell_thresholds that Phase 4.5 REPLACES with v13.
